definitions.explanation: The period at the end of the calendar year, especially December. Often used in commercial and seasonal contexts.

examples.japanese: {歳末|さいまつ}セールが{始|はじ}まった。
{歳末|さいまつ}は{買|か}い{物客|ものきゃく}で{街|まち}が{賑|にぎ}わう。
examples.english: At year-end, the streets bustle with shoppers.

examples.japanese: {歳末|さいまつ}{助|たす}け{合|あ}い{運動|うんどう}に{寄付|きふ}をした。
examples.english: I donated to the year-end charity drive.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal word for the year-end period, commonly seen in advertising, news, and seasonal greetings. More formal than {年末|ねんまつ}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {歳末|さいまつ}セール (year-end sale)
- {歳末|さいまつ}{大売出|おおうりだ}し (year-end grand sale)
- {歳末|さいまつ}{助|たす}け{合|あ}い (year-end mutual aid / charity drive)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{歳末|さいまつ} is more formal and commercial than {年末|ねんまつ}, which is the everyday word for "year-end." {歳末|さいまつ} is especially common in retail and charitable contexts.
